original: iti matsyapurāṇavacanāt | dravyaprokṣaṇasya ca daivapitṛsādhāraṇatvena pitryatvād ity apasavyaṃ [1119] nānuṣṭhānam | brāhmaṇāhvānasya cārthaprāptasyānuvādāt pūrvavad yajñopavītikartavyatvam | pratyutthānasvāgatapraśnāśanopaveśarathyārajopanayanārthapāda-prakṣālanādīni gandhamālyādyalaṃkaraṇaṃ ceti laukikatvāt savyenaiva kāryāṇi | punar nimantraṇadvayaṃ ca pūrvanimantraṇavad daivapitryasthāne savyāpasavyavibhāgenaivānusaṃdheyam | "yathāprathamam ekaṃ [evaṃ?] dvitīyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca" ity āpastambavacanāt, maṇḍalakaraṇatadarcanabrāhmaṇacaraṇakṣālana-tadabhyarcanārghyadānādīni daivāni pitryāṇi ca pūrvaprakaraṇasthaṃ matvā, āśvalāyanaproktasāmānyavacanapratipāditenopavītadharmavibhāgena kāryāṇi | iha keṣucit padārtheṣu vibhāgena savyāpasavyadharmapratipādakā nāgarakhaṇḍoktāḥ slokāḥ prayogapratipādane pradarśayiṣyante | devapitryapādaprakṣālanārcanādyupayuktadravya-śeṣapratipattiḥ | savyāpasavyavibhāgenaiva śrāddhabhūmyāgamanam apy arthaprāptaṃ yajñopavītayuktasyaiva śrāddhasiddhivācanaṃ cobhayātmakatvād vihitatvāc ca prācīnāvītinā kāryam |
analyzed: iti matsyapurāṇa vacanāt dravya prokṣaṇasya ca daiva pitṛ sādhāraṇa tvena pitrya tvāt iti apasavyam na anuṣṭhānam brāhmaṇa āhvānasya ca artha prāptasya anuvādāt pūrvavat yajña upavīti kartavya tvam pratyutthāna svāgata praśna aśana upaveśa rathyā rajaḥ upanayana artha pāda prakṣālana ādīni gandha mālya ādi alaṃkaraṇam ca iti laukika tvāt savyena eva kāryāṇi punar nimantraṇa dvayam ca pūrva nimantraṇa vat daiva pitrya sthāne savya apasavya vibhāg

original: atra triṣu pātreṣv ekadravyeṣu vety etāvat pūrvam eva vyākhyātam | ādhārākāṅkṣāparipūraṇārthaṃ tu punar likhitaṃ darbhāntarhiteṣv iti, dviguṇīkṛtatriśikhadarbhapavitrayukteṣu pātreṣu tūṣṇīm apaḥ pradāya tāsāṃ ca śan no devīr abhiṣṭaya ityādinānumantraṇaṃ kartavyam | tac ca pātratrayaniveśitānām apy apāṃ sakṛd eva tantranyāyena yugapat sarvānumantraṇasaṃbhavāt tāsu caivam anumantritāsv apsu tilo 'sītyādinā pratipātraṃ tilāvāpaḥ kartavyaḥ | atra ca pratyāvāpaṃ mantrāvṛttiḥ, kriyamāṇāvasthasya hi karmaṇaḥ karaṇamantro  'ṅgam | na ca trayāṇāṃ tilāvāpānām ekasmin kāle kriyamāṇatopapadyate | ataḥ kālabhedāt tantrāsaṃbhave mantrāvṛttir āvaśyakī | anumantraṇaṃ tu niṣpāditeṣu karmasu kriyamāṇam aviśeṣāt sarvopakārakaṃ bhaviṣyatīti nāvṛttiṃ labhata iti hariharābhiprāyaḥ | aptilādiprakṣepāṇāṃ prakāram āhs 'prasavyenetyādinā | 'prasavyena' vāmena hastena, 'itarasya' dakṣiṇapāṇeḥ, pradeśinyaṅguṣṭhayor antarāgatena | etad uktaṃ bhavati vāmasya kaniṣṭhikāmūlapradeśe dakṣiṇahastapitṛtīrthasaṃyogaḥ kartavya iti | atra [1284] hetuḥ 'upavītatvād' iti | yathā dakṣiṇena karma kurvato vāmaskandhasthitena yajñopavītena upavītitā bhavati | tathā vāmena karma kurvato dakṣiṇaskandhasthitenopavītitety arthaḥ | dakṣiṇena vā hastena, 'savyopagṛhītena' vāmahastāgraspṛṣṭhena, tilāvāpanādi sarvaṃ kāryam |
analyzed: atra triṣu pātreṣu eka dravyeṣu vā iti etāvat pūrvam eva vyākhyātam ādhāra ākāṅkṣā paripūraṇa artham tu punar likhitam darbha antarhiteṣu iti dvi guṇīkṛta tri śikha darbha pavitra yukteṣu pātreṣu tūṣṇīm apaḥ pradāya tāsām ca śat naḥ devīḥ abhiṣṭaye ityādinā anumantraṇam kartavyam tat ca pātra traya niveśitānām api apām sakṛt eva tantra nyāyena yugapad sarva anumantraṇa saṃbhavāt tāsu ca evam anumantritāsu apsu tilaḥ si ityādinā

original: dakṣiṇena agniṃ svadhaḥ pātraṃ sthāpayet āmāgantu pitaro devayānāt | tilo ’si somadevatyo gosavo devanirmitaḥ pratnavadbhiḥ pṛktaḥ svadhayā pitṝn imān lokān prīṇāhi naḥ svadhā nama iti tilān āropya, madhuvātā [1285] ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ mādhvīr naḥ santv oṣadhīḥ madhu naktam utoṣaso madhumat pārthivaṃ rajaḥ | madhu dyaur astu naḥ pitā madhumān no vanaspatir madhumānas tu sūryaḥ | mādhvīr gāvo bhavantu naḥ | somasya tviṣir asi | śan no devīr abhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye śaṃ yor abhisravantu naḥ | ityetaiḥ svadhā miśrīkṛtya nirastan namuceḥ śira iti kiṃcin nirasya gandha-puṣpākṣataiḥ pitṛbhyo namaḥ pitāmahebhyo namaḥ prapitāmahebhyo nama ityarcayitvā darbhaiḥ pracchādayet |
analyzed: dakṣiṇena agnim svadhaḥ pātram sthāpayet pitaraḥ deva yānāt tilaḥ si soma devatyaḥ gosavaḥ deva nirmitaḥ pratnavadbhiḥ pṛktaḥ svadhayā pitṝn imān lokān prīṇāhi naḥ svadhā namaḥ iti tilān āropya madhuvātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ mādhvīḥ naḥ santu oṣadhīḥ madhu naktam uta uṣasaḥ madhumat pārthivam rajaḥ madhu dyauḥ astu naḥ pitā madhumān naḥ vanaspatiḥ madhumānaḥ tu sūryaḥ mādhvīḥ gāvaḥ bhavantu naḥ somasya

original: asyārthaḥ | agnidakṣiṇena anvāhāryapacanasyāvasathyasya vāgner dakṣiṇataḥ svadhāpātre arghyodakadhāraṇārthaṃ pātraṃ sthāpayann āmāgantu pitaro devayānād ityādikaṃ mantram uccārayet | tadanantaraṃ tilo ’sītyādinā mantreṇa tilān prakṣipya madhuvātetyādibhir mantrair madhughṛtodakarūpāṃ svadhāṃ miśrīkuryāt | tatra madhuprakāśakatvān madhuvātā iti tṛcena madhuprakṣepaḥ | tviṣis tejaḥ tejo vai ghṛtam iti ghṛtaprakāśakatvāt somasya tviṣir asīty anena ghṛtaprakṣepaḥ | udakaprakāśakatvāc channo devīr ity anenodakaprakṣepaḥ | tato nirastaṃ namuceḥ śira ity anenāvakaranirasanaṃ kuryāt | pitṛbhyo nama ityādimantratrayeṇa pratyekaṃ gandhapuṣpākṣataṃ nikṣipyopari kuśatrayaṃ nidadhyāt |
analyzed: asya arthaḥ agni dakṣiṇena anvāhāryapacanasya āvasathyasya vā agneḥ dakṣiṇatas svadhā pātre arghya udaka dhāraṇa artham pātram sthāpayan pitaraḥ deva yānāt iti ādikam mantram uccārayet tad anantaram tilaḥ si ityādinā mantreṇa tilān prakṣipya madhuvāta ityādibhiḥ mantraiḥ madhu ghṛta udaka rūpām svadhām miśrīkuryāt tatra madhu prakāśaka tvāt madhuvātāḥ iti tṛcena madhu prakṣepaḥ tviṣiḥ tejaḥ tejaḥ vai ghṛtam iti ghṛta prakāśaka tv

original: te ca mantrāḥ | āmāgantu pitaro devayānāt payaḥsamudrāt saritāt suvargāt asmin yajñe sarvakāmān labhantām akṣīyamāṇam uhyatām imāṃ pitṛbhyo vo gṛhṇāmīti | madhu vātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ mādhvīr naḥ santv oṣadhīḥ madhu nakam utoṣaso madhumat pārthivaṃ rajaḥ | madhu dyaur astu naḥ pitā madhumān no vanaspatir madhumān astu sūryaḥ | mādhvīr [1286] gāvo bhavantu naḥ | somasya tviṣir asi taveva me tviṣir bhūyādi ti yajuḥ | nirastaṃ namuceḥ śira ity etad etāvad eva yajuḥ |
analyzed: te ca mantrāḥ pitaraḥ deva yānāt payaḥ samudrāt saritāt suvargāt asmin yajñe sarva kāmān labhantām a kṣīyamāṇam uhyatām imām pitṛbhyaḥ vaḥ gṛhṇāmi iti madhu vātāḥ ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ mādhvīḥ naḥ santu oṣadhīḥ madhu nakam uta uṣasaḥ madhumat pārthivam rajaḥ madhu dyauḥ astu naḥ pitā madhumān naḥ vanaspatiḥ madhumān astu sūryaḥ mādhvīḥ gāvaḥ bhavantu naḥ somasya tviṣiḥ asi tava iva me tviṣiḥ bhūyāt it

original: atra pratīkagṛhīto mantro vaiśvadevārghyaprakaraṇe darśitaḥ | utpavanaṃ tu tūṣṇīm eva kartavyam | kecit tu devo vaḥ savitotpunātv acchidreṇa pavitreṇa vasoḥ sūryasya raśmibhir ity etena yajuṣotpavanaṃ kurvate | nigame tu sāgnikakartṛke ṣaḍdaivatye śrāddhe catvāry aghyapātrāṇi teṣāṃ ca dakṣiṇābhimukhollikhitalekhāyāṃ sthāpanaṃ sragādiṣaḍdravyopetānāṃ adbhiḥ prapūraṇam | tatra ca mantrāntarāṇy uktāni ullikhya dakṣiṇālekhāyāṃ kṛtvā lauhāṃś camasāṃś caturaḥ sraktilapayodadhimadhughṛtamiśrān mahāvyāhṛtyāpohiṣṭīyaśannodevīrity adbhiḥ prapūryeti |

original: 'srak’ puṣpamālā | ‘lauhān' trapusomakṛṣṇāyasavyatiriktais taijasadhātubhir viracitān | tāṃś catuḥsaṃkhyakān yathoktāyāṃ lekhāyāṃ samāsādya, atra caturthasya mātāmahādyarghyārthatā vakṣyate | tāṃś ca sragādiṣaḍdravyopetān kṛtvā mahāvyāhṛtyādibhir mantrair adbhiḥ prapūrayet | bhūr bhuvaḥ svar iti mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ | 'āpohiṣṭīyaṃ' āpohiṣṭā mayobhuva (?) ityādinavarcasūktam | anye tu jalatilakuśakusumayavagandhākhyāni ṣaḍarghyadravyāṇy āhuḥ | tathācārghyaṃ dadyād ity anuvṛttau kālikāpurāṇe |

original: ato ’nagnaḥ (?) śūdrasyāmānnaśrāddhe agnaukaraṇānuvādenāmadravyakatvākhyaviśeṣāvidhānād anagner vācanikam agnaukaraṇaṃ tadākṣitaṃ cānagnirūpaṃ pāṇyadhikaraṇam iti | atra yady api viprasyeti sāmānyenoktaṃ tathāpi prakṛtatvāt saṃnihitaparityāge kāraṇābhāvāc ca śrāddhabhokur eva viprasyeti manyate | pradhānasya pratyaṅgam āvṛtter niṣedhāt viprasyeti vivakṣitakavacanāc [1340] caikasyaiva śraiṣṭhaprāthamyābhyāṃ prathamopaviṣṭasyaiveti | yair daivikakarmadharmeṇa yajñopavītena svāhākāreṇa cāyaṃ homaḥ kriyate tair daivikaviprakare kartavyaḥ | yaiś ca paitṛkakarmadharmeṇa prācīnāvītena svadhāśabdena ca kriyate tais tu paitṛkaviprakare kāryaḥ | sarvair vā devakare paitṛkakare vā vikalpena kāryaḥ | yady api karaśabdaḥ sādhāraṇas tathāpi dakṣiṇakareṇa kartavyam iti dakṣiṇasya sarvakarmāhartāsmaraṇāt "pāṇau dadyāt tu dakṣiṇa iti" vacanāc ca dakṣiṇa eva kare homaḥ | tatra tāvat prathamopaviṣṭasya paitṛkasya pāṇau homa ity āha kātyāyanaḥ |

original: sarvam annam ekasmin pātre uddharet | sarvaśabdaḥ prakṛtānnajātisarvatvārthaḥ | ato māṃsapāyasaudanāpūpasūpādijātīyebhyaḥ prakṛtaśrāddhaprayogārthaṃ sādhitebhyaḥ sarvebhyo ’nnebhyaḥ kiṃcit kiṃcid ādāya piṇḍaparyāptaparimāṇam annasamudāyam ekasmin pātre saṃbhṛtyety etad uktaṃ bhavati | 'ucchiṣṭasamīpa' ity ucchiṣṭapradeśāt vyāmatryaratnibāhvādivyavahite deśe | atra piṇḍapitṛyajñavad upacāraḥ | pitrya iti sūtritavād darbhagrahaṇam upamūlasakṛdācchinopalakṣaṇārthaṃ | parisaṃkhyānārtham iti kecit | 'avanejya' pradāsyamānasyaikaikasya piṇḍasya sthāne uddeśyasya pitrāder (?) ekaikasya gotrasaṃbandhanāmāni saṃbudhya tāni samuccāryāvanenikṣveti pātreṇa satilaṃ jalaṃ ninīyety arthaḥ | 'trīṃs trīn' itivīpsā mātāmahādipiṇḍatrayam apekṣya, 'piṇḍān dadyāt', parasparasaṃśleṣād vibhāgaṃ parityajya saṅghātatāṃ prāptam annaṃ piṇḍaḥ | evaṃ saṃpūrṇam anācānteṣu pātravimocanārthaṃ sakṛtgṛhītagaṇḍūṣeṣu brāhmaṇeṣu gāyatrījapādi kṛtvā piṇḍān dadyād ity ekeṣāṃ matam abhidhāyānyeṣāṃ matam āha 'ācānteṣv eka' iti | 'eka' iti ekavacanād asya pakṣasya paramatatvam iti na mantavyam ubhayaśāstratvād vikalpa iti karkokteḥ | astu caika iti vacanāt prathame paratvāt pareṣām evaiṣa pakṣa iti | kecit tv anācānteṣv eva vikirārtham annam ādāya tṛptipraśnottarapūrvakaṃ śeṣānnānujñāvacanaṃ kārayitvā vikiraṃ [1406] prakṣipya brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sakṛt sakṛd apo datvānantaraṃ piṇḍadānaṃ kurvanti |
analyzed: sarvam annam ekasmin pātre uddharet sarva śabdaḥ prakṛta anna jāti sarva tva arthaḥ atas māṃsa pāyasa odana apūpa sūpa ādi jātīyebhyaḥ prakṛta śrāddha prayoga artham sādhitebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ nnebhyaḥ kiṃcid kiṃcid ādāya piṇḍa paryāpta parimāṇam anna samudāyam ekasmin pātre saṃbhṛtya iti etat uktam bhavati ucchiṣṭa samīpe iti ucchiṣṭa pradeśāt vyāma tri aratni bāhu ādi vyavahite deśe atra piṇḍapitṛyajña vat upacāraḥ pitryaḥ iti sūt

analyzed: gāyatrīm anuśrāvya tṛptān jñātvā svaditam iti pṛṣṭvā śeṣam annam anujñāpya prakṛtāt annāt vikiram kuryāt svadhām vācayitvā viṣṭarān trīn nidadhyāt trīṇi eva ada pātrāṇi sa tilāni sa pavitrāṇi mṛd maya aśma maya audumbarāṇi vā dhūpa gandha mālya ādarśa pradīpa añjana ādīni ca upaharet sarva anna prakāram ādāya piṇḍān nidadhyāt

original: asyārthaḥ | gāyatrīṁ ‘anuśrāvya' yathā te brāhmaṇaḥ śṛṇvanti tathoccārya, 'tṛptān' suhitān, jñātvā svaditam iti pṛṣṭvā śobhanam aditaṃ 'svaditaṃ' | arthāt susvaditam iti uttaraṃ gamyate | śeṣam annaṃ kiṃ kriyatām iṣṭhaiḥ saha bhujyatām iti praśnottarābhyāṃ anujñāpyānujñātād annāt kiyadannam uddhṛtya tasya bhūmau vikiraṇaṃ kuryāt | svadhāṃ vācayiṣya ityādinā prakāreṇa svadhāṃ vācayitvā nidhāsyamānasyaikaikasya piṇḍasyādhārabhūta ekaiko viṣṭara iti piṇḍatrayārthaṃ trīn viṣṭarān bhūmau nidadhyāt | pūrvāgranthitapañcaviṃśatidarbhapiñjūlātmako viṣṭaraḥ | ekaikasmin piṇḍe ekaikena pātreṇāvanejanaṃ kartuṃ trīṇy eva mṛcchilātāmrāṇām anyatamena nirmitāni [1407] pavitrasahitāny udapātrāṇi | 'dhūpaḥ' gugguluniryāsādiḥ | 'gandhāḥ' śrāddhe vihitāni surabhīṇy anulepanāni | 'mālyāni' śrāddhocitāni grathitapuṣpāṇi | ‘ādarśaḥ' darpaṇaḥ, ādṛśyate 'smin rūpam ity ādarśaḥ | ādiśabdāt prasādhanadravyaṃ sindūrādīti hariharaḥ | 'pradīpaḥ' prasiddhaḥ | 'añjanaṃ' sauvīrādi | ādiśabdo ’bhyañjanavāsaḥprabhṛtyupayogidravyāntarasaṃgrahārthaḥ | etāni ca 'upahareta' piṇḍadeśasamīpe nidadhyāt | sarvam annaprakāram ādāya tad ekīkṛtya tanmayān piṇḍān nidadhyād iti |
analyzed: asya arthaḥ gāyatrīṁ anuśrāvya yathā te brāhmaṇaḥ śṛṇvanti tathā uccārya tṛptān su hitān jñātvā svaditam iti pṛṣṭvā śobhanam aditam svaditam arthāt su svaditam iti uttaram gamyate śeṣam annam kim kriyatām iṣṭhaiḥ saha bhujyatām iti praśna uttarābhyām anujñāpya anujñātāt annāt kiyat annam uddhṛtya tasya bhūmau vikiraṇam kuryāt svadhām vācayiṣye ityādinā prakāreṇa svadhām vācayitvā nidhāsyamānasya ekaikasya piṇḍasya adhārayan an

analyzed: apraśasteṣu yāgeṣu saṃpiṇḍīkaraṇāt pūrveṣu pretaśrāddheṣu avanejanam avācīna pāṇinā nirvapaṇam iti smṛticandrikā kāraḥ piṇḍa nirvapaṇa ārambha padārthena avanejana ākhyena piṇḍa dānam lakṣyate iti api śakyam vyākhyātum bhojanasya pūrvam bhojanāt pūrvam iti arthaḥ praśastam sapiṇḍīkaraṇa ādi śrāddheṣu kriyamāṇam bhojanāt paścāt eva yathākālam iyam ca vyavasthā keṣāṃcid eva śākhinām yatas manu ādi smṛti matsya ādipu

original: mukhyapārvaṇaṃ piṇḍānvāhāryakarma vādhikṛtya piṇḍadānasya bhojanāt pūrvam eva kālacodanā | ata eva pārvaṇaśrāddhe bhojanāt paścād eveti smṛticandrikākāroktir apy evam eva vyākhyeyā | yeṣāṃ tu gṛhyādau piṇḍadānasya kālaviśeṣā noktāḥ teṣāṃ tu saukaryād ācānteṣv eka ity ayam eva [1409] pakṣo grahītuṃ nyāyyaḥ | atra prasaṅgād vikiradānakālavikalpā api vyākhyātāḥ |
analyzed: mukhya pārvaṇam piṇḍānvāhārya karma vā adhikṛtya piṇḍa dānasya bhojanāt pūrvam eva kāla codanā atas eva pārvaṇa śrāddhe bhojanāt paścāt eva iti smṛticandrikā kāra uktiḥ api evam eva vyākhyeyā yeṣām tu gṛhya ādau piṇḍa dānasya kāla viśeṣāḥ na uktāḥ teṣām tu saukaryāt ācānteṣu ekaḥ iti ayam eva pakṣaḥ grahītum nyāyyaḥ atra prasaṅgāt vikira dāna kāla vikalpāḥ api vyākhyātāḥ

original: tatra tāvat piṇḍapitṛyajñe ’gnisamīpe piṇḍanirvāpaṃ vidhāya piṇḍapitṛyajñavad upacāraḥ | pitrya ityādiṣu ca piṇḍapitṛyajñavidhyantātideśād agnisadbhāve tatsamīpa eva piṇḍān dadyāt | tathā ca brāhmaṇabhojanāt pūrvakālīnaṃ piṇḍanirvāpaṃ varṇayatā devalena bhuvi piṇḍānāṃ saṃniveśanam añjanādibhis tadalaṃkaraṇaṃ coktvā anantaram agnaukaraṇahomam abhidhāya tasya homasya pūrvaniveśitapiṇḍasaṃnidhānam uktam |

original: iti piṇḍānāṃ saṃnidhāv evamuktena prakāreṇāgniṃ hutvānantaram ebhyaḥ piṇḍebhyaḥ pakvānnena baliṃ naivedyarūpaṃ dadyāt | atrāgnau homasya piṇḍasaṃnidhānaṃ vadatārthāt piṇḍānām apy agnisaṃnidhānam uktam | agnyabhāve tu pūrvopanyasteṣu śaṅkha-kātyāyana- yājñavalkya-vacaneṣūcchiṣṭasaṃnidhāv ity upadeśād ucchiṣṭasamīpe dadyād iti madhuśarmaprabhṛtayaḥ |

original: saṃkalpaśabdenātra dvijabhojanasya tyāgo ’bhidhīyate | atraitāni yathāvat pratipādayed iti kathane 'nanyatraiteṣv ekatamavaikalye ’pi na vaiguṇyam iti gamyate| atra gotrasaṃbandhanāmnāṃ kiṃvibhaktyantānām abhidhānaṃ kartavyam ity apekṣāyāṃ kaścit tāvad evaṃ manyate | etat te ity etanmantrasthaṃ te iti padaṃ na tāvat prathamāvahuvacanāntasya prathamādvivacanāntasya vā tadorūpam, tasya prakṛtānupayogāt | ata eva caturthyekavacanāntasya ṣaṣṭhyekavacanāntasya vā yuṣmadorūpaṃ vācyam | tatra devatāyāḥ saṃpradānasārūpyāt tadvācinaḥ śabdasya caturthyantataiva yuktā | ataś cānena sahānvayākāṅkṣiṇāṃ gotrasaṃbandhanāmnāṃ caturthyekavacanāntānām evābhidhānaṃ kartavyaṃ | pitrādīnāṃ devatātvaṃ caivaṃvidha evābhidhāne kṛte prakāśyate nānyathā | ato yathoktam abhidhānaṃ kartavyam iti | aparas tv āha | yuṣmadaḥ parokṣavyāvṛttavyaktiviṣayatvād bahuṣu samakṣasthiteṣv ekasyābhimukhīkaraṇārthatvena saṃbuddher evopayuktatamatvāt tadantānām eva gotrasaṃbandhanāmnām abhidhānaṃ yuktam | asāv [1435] iti prathamānirdeśasyāvivakṣāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāc ca | yas tu loke prayogaḥ "sa kathaṃ vīrāyate druhyati sa kutas tvāṃ caitraṃ jeṣyati” iti sa tu tadavasthasya kārakatābhidhāyakatvena vā prakārāntarābhimukhīkṛtayuṣmadarthādhiṣṭhānaviṣayatvena vā hetuparatvena vā praśaṃsārthatvena vopayujyate | prakṛte punar eteṣāṃ madhye naikasyāpi saṃbhavaḥ | pramītasya hi pūrvajanmapravṛttagotrasaṃbandhanāmnām idānīm avartamānatvena kṣetrajñaviśeṣopalakṣakatvāt kārakādirūpasvārthasamarpakatvāyogāt | ataḥ saṃbudhyantānām eva gotrādīnām abhidhānaṃ kartavyam | sūtrāntare caivam evābhidhānaṃ dṛśyate etat te pitar etat te pitāmahaitat te prapitāmahetyādi | etad ity ayaṃ nirvapsyamānasya piṇḍasya nirdeśaḥ |
analyzed: saṃkalpa śabdena atra dvija bhojanasya tyāgaḥ abhidhīyate atra etāni yathāvat pratipādayet iti kathane na anyatra eteṣu ekatama vaikalye na vaiguṇyam iti gamyate atra gotra saṃbandha nāmnām kiṃvibhakti antānām abhidhānam kartavyam iti apekṣāyām kaścid tāvat evam manyate etat te iti etat mantra stham te iti padam na tāvat prathamā vahuvacana antasya prathamā dvivacana antasya vā tadorūpam tasya prakṛta anupayogāt atas eva caturthī ekavacana antasya ṣaṣṭhī ekavacan

original: ucyate | "praviśya piṇḍīkuḍyasya piṇḍaṃ patati" iti mahābhāṣyādau piṇḍaśabdasya strīnapuṃsakayor api prayogadarśanāt napuṃsakena nirdeśo na virudhyate | upādhyāyakarkas tv annam ity adhyāhāraḥ kārya ity uktavān | tat tu smṛticandrikākāro na manyate | sa hy āha | ananyagatitve ’dhyāhāraḥ kriyeta | na cātrānanyagatitvaṃ, piṇḍaśabdasya napuṃsakaliṅgasya darśitatvād iti | atredam ucyate | nāyaṃ napuṃsakaprayogopapādanārtham adhyāhāraḥ | kiṃ tu mantravākyaparipūraṇārthaḥ | anumataś ca “iṣe tvetyādaucchidmītyāder vākyaparipūraṇārtho ’dhyāhāraḥ | dṛśyate cedaṃ kṣetram idaṃ gṛham idaṃ dhanaṃ tubhyaṃ dīyata iti loke prayogaḥ | upalakṣaṇārthaś ca karkabhāṣye ’nnaśabdaḥ | ataś caitat te ity asyānantaraṃ annam iti piṇḍam iti vādhyāhāraḥ kāryaḥ |
